items.title: Batting Average (AVG)
items.summary: Hits divided by at-bats.

items.title: On-Base Percentage (OBP)
items.summary: Times reached base divided by plate appearances.

items.title: Slugging Percentage (SLG)
items.summary: Total bases divided by at-bats.

items.title: On-base Plus Slugging (OPS)
items.summary: OBP + SLG.

items.title: Home Run (HR)
items.summary: A batter reaches all bases and scores on a hit.

items.title: Run Batted In (RBI)
items.summary: A run driven in by a batter.

items.title: Stolen Base (SB)
items.summary: A runner advances a base without a hit.

items.title: Strikeout (SO/K)
items.summary: A batter is out on strikes.

items.title: Base on Balls (BB)
items.summary: Four balls award first base.

items.title: Earned Run Average (ERA)
items.summary: Earned runs per nine innings.

items.title: Walks plus Hits per Inning Pitched (WHIP)
items.summary: Baserunners allowed per inning pitched.

items.title: Exit Velocity (EV)
items.summary: Speed of the ball off the bat, in mph.

items.title: Launch Angle (LA)
items.summary: Vertical angle of the ball off the bat, in degrees.

items.title: Hard-Hit Rate
items.summary: Share of batted balls with exit velocity >= 95 mph.

items.title: Barrel
items.summary: A batted ball with an optimal combination of exit velocity and launch angle.

items.title: Postseason
items.summary: Wild Card, Division Series, League Championship and World Series games.

items.title: Regular Season
items.summary: The 162-game major league season.

items.title: World Series
items.summary: The MLB championship series.

items.title: Whiff Rate
items.summary: Share of swings that miss.

items.title: Spin Rate
items.summary: Pitch spin rate in revolutions per minute.
